description: leftoff: inject where you left off at session start; record session checkpoints and ends.

hooks.command: L="${LEFTOFF_HOME:-$HOME/.leftoff}/bin/leftoff"; if [ -x "$L" ]; then "$L" hook claude-session-start; elif command -v leftoff >/dev/null 2>&1; then leftoff hook claude-session-start; fi; exit 0
L="${LEFTOFF_HOME:-$HOME/.leftoff}/bin/leftoff"; if [ -x "$L" ]; then "$L" hook claude-stop; elif command -v leftoff >/dev/null 2>&1; then leftoff hook claude-stop; fi; exit 0
L="${LEFTOFF_HOME:-$HOME/.leftoff}/bin/leftoff"; if [ -x "$L" ]; then "$L" hook claude-session-end; elif command -v leftoff >/dev/null 2>&1; then leftoff hook claude-session-end; fi; exit 0
